questions.title: 尊敬的比你年长的人
questions.text:
Describe someone who is older than you that you admire
You should say:
Who this person is
How you knew this person
What kinds of things you like to do together
And explain how you feel about this person
questions.english:
Someone older than me whom I'd like to describe is my supervisor. I got to know them through my master's studies in artificial intelligence and robotics. What I admire is the way they combine knowledge with a patient attitude towards students.

We enjoy discussing research ideas and looking at problems from different angles. Sometimes I arrive with a technical question and think there must be one quick answer. They encourage me to explain my reasoning first, which often helps me notice a weakness in my own approach.

We also talk about the wider purpose of research. Since I want to study abroad for a PhD, those conversations would be relevant to how I think about my future. I like that the discussion is serious without making me afraid to ask questions.

I feel both respect and gratitude towards them. I'm generally quiet, so having someone who listens carefully makes it easier for me to speak openly. Their example suggests that being experienced isn't just about knowing more. It's also about helping other people become more independent.
questions.chinese:
我想描述的一位比我年长的人是我的导师。我们通过我的人工智能和机器人硕士学习认识。我敬佩的是导师把知识与对学生的耐心结合起来。

我们喜欢讨论研究想法，从不同角度看问题。有时，我带着技术问题来，并认为一定有一个快速答案。导师会鼓励我先解释思路，这往往帮助我发现自己方法中的弱点。

我们也会讨论研究更广泛的目的。因为我希望出国读博，这些交谈与我思考未来有关。我喜欢这种认真、却不会让我不敢提问的讨论。

我对导师既尊敬又感激。我平常比较安静，有一位认真倾听的人，会让我更容易坦率表达。导师的例子说明，有经验不只是懂得更多，也包括帮助别人变得更独立。
pending: 导师年龄较大、具体讨论和指导方式是候选；导师很好和硕士身份已确认

questions.title: 好的购物服务
questions.text:
Describe a time when you received good service in a shop/store/company
You should say:
Where the shop/store/company is
When you went to the shop/store/company
What service you received from the staff
And explain how you felt about the service
questions.english:
A time I received good service was when I went to a computer shop in Guangdong last year to look for a laptop. I was choosing something for both my studies and programming, so I needed more help than just being told which model was popular.

The member of staff first asked what I wanted to use it for and what mattered most to me. They then explained a few options in plain language. Instead of pushing the most expensive model, they showed me which differences would actually affect my work.

I also had a question about setting the computer up. They took some time to demonstrate the basic steps and made sure I understood what to do. I didn't feel rushed, even when I asked another question.

I appreciated the service because it helped me make a rational choice. A computer is useful to me as an AI student and someone who enjoys coding, so I wanted to get the decision right. The experience felt comfortable because the staff listened carefully and gave practical advice without putting pressure on me.
questions.chinese:
我获得良好服务的一次经历，是去年去广东的一家电脑商店选笔记本电脑。我希望它能用于专业学习和编程，因此需要的不只是别人告诉我哪款热门。

店员先问我打算用它做什么，最看重什么，然后用简单语言解释几个选择。店员没有强推最贵的型号，而是告诉我哪些差异真正会影响我的工作。

我还问了电脑初始设置的问题。店员花时间演示基本步骤，确保我知道如何操作。即使我又问了一个问题，也没有感觉被催促。

我很感激这种服务，因为它帮助我理性选择。作为人工智能学生和编程爱好者，电脑对我很有用，因此我希望做对选择。这次体验让我很舒服，因为店员认真倾听、提供实用建议，也没有给我施压。

questions.title: 尊敬的比你年长的人
questions.text: What kinds of things do the elderly remember for a long time?
questions.english: Older people may remember emotionally important moments, such as childhood experiences, family events, and their first job. Familiar places and friendships can also remain vivid. These memories often carry a personal meaning, rather than being random facts. However, everyone is different, and I wouldn't assume that all older people remember the same things or forget recent events.
questions.chinese: 年长者可能记得情感重要的时刻，比如童年经历、家庭事件和第一份工作。熟悉的地方与友谊也可能记忆鲜明。这些记忆往往有个人意义，而非随意事实。不过每个人不同，我不会假设所有老人记得同样事情或忘记近期事件。

questions.text: Why is there a generation gap between the young and the old?
questions.english: Different generations grow up with different technology, social expectations, and opportunities. That can influence how they think about work, relationships, or money. Young people may see a new tool as normal while older people find it unfamiliar. But a gap doesn't have to become a conflict. Patient conversation can help both sides understand the experiences behind their opinions.

questions.text: Can consumption drive economic growth?
questions.english: Yes, when people buy goods and services, businesses receive income and may hire more staff or expand production. That supports other businesses too, such as suppliers. I think consumption helps most when it meets real needs and is supported by stable income, rather than pressure to keep buying unnecessary things.
